pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR0126 first-release completion by hardening the production Timeline contract before Project Rust and Sequencer integration. Multi-player composition now has explicit priority with deterministic tie-breaks and diagnostics, Timeline events retain stable asset + semantic document identity, continuous Animation sampling no longer fabricates seek discontinuities, neutral loop semantics are exposed through the production runtime, and unsaved Editor working copies can compile through the same runtime path.

The shared Timeline authoring service also gains transactional duration, rename, typed clip-payload, and marker-event edits so the Sequencer does not bypass CLI/MCP-equivalent authoring semantics.

The PR remains Draft while Project Rust control, the dedicated Sequencer workspace, and final Windows/Visual Validation continue.
